claim_one_line: WITTEN'S DOUBLET-TRIPLET TOPOLOGY ON THE FIGURE-EIGHT'S EVEN FILLINGS (P-408; data-free; PROVED for the topology): each of m004(p/q)'s three involutions (two strong inversions, one period) has exactly two fixed circles when p is even (explicit branch links L11n132, L13n4507, L13n4800, L14n24777; odd p gives knots); either strong inversion preserves the unique order-2 line W = diag(1,1,1,-1,-1) (SU(5) -> SM) and necessarily lifts trivially on one circle and by W on the other; the period preserves the Z/6 line and splits by W^3 when 6 | p and p = 2 mod 4 -- Witten's topological structure at n = 2, where his first model fails with Z/2 alone (his own caveat); the full Sym(Q) = Z/2 x Z/2 admits 6 enumerated solutions (realisation open, P-409). Structural; none of the 19.
